changes.text: 1768年6月中旬，叫魂的谣言传进了江西。它走的是江西东面的信江河谷，那是通往邻省浙江的一条便捷通道。江西巡抚吴绍诗年约七十。谣言已经进了他的辖境，他没有向朝廷奏报。

In the middle of June 1768, rumours of soulstealing reached Jiangxi. They came through the Xin River valley on Jiangxi's eastern side, the easy route into the neighbouring province of Zhejiang. The governor of Jiangxi, Wu Shaoshi, was about seventy. The rumours had entered his jurisdiction, and he sent no report to the court.
回到6月。谣言入境，吴绍诗没有奏报。他后来向弘历报告说，自己曾口头命令属下留意可疑的行旅，但没有人被捕，省内也没有发现剪辫的事。对他不奏报谣言，弘历只是温和地驳斥他：「汝误矣」，意思是你做错了。孔飞力说，弘历对这位年高誉隆的巡抚表现出了出乎意料的克制。

Back to June. The rumours had crossed the border, and Wu Shaoshi sent no report. He later told Hongli that he had verbally ordered his subordinates to keep an eye on suspicious travellers, but no one had been arrested and no cases of queue-clipping had turned up in the province. On the failure to report the rumours, the emperor rebuked him only mildly: "You were wrong." Kuhn calls it an unexpected show of restraint toward an elderly and highly respected governor.
到了10月初，吴绍诗交上一份很不一样的报告。他说自己在省内布下了一张比任何别省都严密的警网：挑选干员「改装易姓」，换了装束、改了姓名，分赴各县秘密查缉，每旬报告一次有无可疑人物；又令各府州派精细强干的人，去查访「庵观寺院祠堂书馆及深山密箐等处」，查访范围从寺庙道观、祠堂书馆，一直到深山密林。

In early October, Wu Shaoshi sent in a very different kind of report. He said he had spread a net across his province tighter than any other province's. He had picked capable agents who would "change their dress and take other surnames," so that they could travel in disguise and search each county in secret, with a report every ten days on whether anyone suspicious had appeared. He had also ordered each prefecture and department to send sharp, able men to search "convents, temples and monasteries, ancestral halls, schools, and deep mountains and dense thickets." The places named ran from religious houses and ancestral halls to the remotest forest.
吴绍诗的奏报里还有一段警告。他说那些从事「左道邪术」的人，借创立烧香好善会的名义，「阳则聚集乡愚男妇，阴则勾结亡命棍徒」，明面上聚集乡间男女，暗地里勾结亡命之徒；又借避灾防盗之名，造作妖言、制备军器、诱人归附。他要求不论僧道还是其他人，凡是面生可疑、神气沮丧、迁徙无定、怕见人的，都要立即报告地方官。弘历的朱批是：「恐属空言，实难信矣口」，恐怕只是空话，实在难以相信。这是一句明白的怀疑。

In his memorials Wu Shaoshi also issued a warning. Practitioners of "heterodox ways and evil arts," he wrote, set up incense-burning charitable societies as a front, "openly gathering ignorant village men and women, secretly colluding with desperadoes and ruffians." On the pretext of warding off disaster and bandits, they spread wicked talk, stockpiled weapons and drew people into their following. He ordered that anyone, monk, Daoist priest or layman, who was an unfamiliar face, looked dejected, kept moving from place to place, or avoided being seen, be reported to the local officials at once. Hongli's rescript read: "I fear these are empty words; truly hard to believe." It was open doubt.
风险同样有记录可查。弘历在吴绍诗的这段警告上批了「恐属空言」；「老菩萨」的名声和消极误事的担心，危机前一年就摆在了皇帝面前；苏尔德的下场则说明，不报和阻挠可以被单独挑出来重罚。本文作者推断，吴绍诗躲过去，很大程度上靠的是别人借不来的条件，同样的做法换一个人，换来的可能是另一种朱批。

The risks are on record too. Hongli wrote "I fear these are empty words" in response to Wu Shaoshi's warning. The Old Bodhisattva nickname, and the worry that he was too passive, had reached the emperor a year before the crisis. Su'erde's fate shows that failing to report and obstructing the campaign could earn an official a heavy punishment of his own. My inference is that Wu Shaoshi got through largely on advantages no one else could borrow. Another official doing the same thing might have received a very different rescript.
本文唯一的依据是孔飞力《叫魂》的中译本（陈兼、刘昶译），没有使用其他史源。朱批和奏报都转引自书中译文，与档案原文是否逐字一致无法判断。“只是装模作样”是孔飞力的推断，他先列出过警网根本抓不到人的可能，但据江西没有刑求和伪证，认为只能相信装模作样的解释；吴绍诗为何难以受罚，孔飞力归于他的法律造诣，并推测可能还有高晋的袒护。高晋答应的后续报告，孔飞力没有找到。

This article rests entirely on the Chinese translation of Kuhn's Soulstealers, by Chen Jian and Liu Chang, and uses no other source. The rescripts and memorials are quoted as they appear in that translation, so I cannot tell whether they match the archival originals word for word, and the English renderings here are translations of that Chinese text. The claim that Wu Shaoshi was merely putting on a show is Kuhn's inference. Kuhn first named the possibility that the net simply could not catch anyone, but, finding no torture or false testimony in Jiangxi, concluded that only the explanation of a show was credible. As for why Wu Shaoshi was hard to punish, Kuhn attributes it to his legal expertise and conjectures that Gao Jin's protection may also have played a part. Kuhn was unable to find the follow-up report Gao Jin promised.

Nor is this a story of a wise man outwitting a tyrant. Kuhn lists several forms that bureaucratic resistance may have taken. Some was deliberate. Some came from sluggish procedures that kept officials from reacting to an emergency in time. Some officials, doubting the whole thing, may have refused to take the cases seriously. Others may have feared that the suppression campaign would endanger their careers. And some upright officials may have refused to persecute innocent people on the strength of false accusations. Kuhn writes that these actions do not look coordinated, and that resisting despotic power does not require collusion. This article cannot say which of these describes Wu Shaoshi. Kuhn also cautions that saying Hongli "used" political crime is no closer to the truth than saying political crime "used" him. My own reading is that the quiet in Jiangxi and the seventy arrests in Suzhou came out of the same structure. What differed was how each official handled the same pressure.

dispositions.rationale: 删去“从浙江”/“from Zhejiang”。证据只说谣言经信江河谷这条通往浙江的通道传入江西，没有说谣言来自浙江。英文第二句补出“of Zhejiang”，与中文“邻省浙江”保持一致。

evidence.quote: 江西东面的信江河谷是连接邻省浙江的便捷通道，叫魂的谣言早在6月中旬就从这里悄悄地传人了江西

dispositions.rationale: 把“只回了一句”改为“只是温和地驳斥他”，英文同步改写。同时删去重复的“这是驳斥，却只是温和的一句”，不再断言回应只有一句。

evidence.quote: 只是温和地驳斥了他：对谣言来加奏报是“汝误矣”

dispositions.rationale: 英文改为“with a report every ten days”，不再指定由谁报告。末句改为奏报所列的查访地点范围，不写成实际执行的搜查。中文末句同样改为“查访范围从……一直到深山密林”。

evidence.quote: 并每旬一次报告有无可疑人物
要么是吴的警网从来就没有真正地动用过

dispositions.rationale: 开头改为“吴绍诗的奏报里还有一段警告”/“In his memorials Wu Shaoshi also issued a warning”，不再把这段警告归入10月初那份报告。末句删去“针对的正是这份奏报”/“aimed squarely at this report”。

evidence.quote: 他在先前奏报中提出的忧心忡忡的警告和精心布置的查缉

dispositions.rationale: 把“在那份奏报上”/“on that very report”改为“在吴绍诗的这段警告上”/“in response to Wu Shaoshi's warning”。证据只显示这条朱批批在这段警告上，不能固定到某一份奏报。

evidence.quote: 朱批：“恐属空言，实难信矣口”

dispositions.rationale: 把“倾向于”/“leaned toward”改为孔飞力的原有说法：他据江西没有刑求和伪证，认为“只能相信”。这样也与analysis.0的转述一致。

evidence.quote: 据此，我们只能相信，巡抚吴绍诗根本就不打算查缉这个他认为是误传的案子

dispositions.rationale: 把英文“a purge”改为“the suppression campaign”。这里的清剿指对妖党的清剿，不是对官员的整肃，改后与中文意思和全文用词一致。

evidence.quote: 害怕清剿会危及自己的仕途
